head: Open Screen Sharing app controls your Mac from iPhone and iPad
dek: Open Screen Sharing is a remote desktop app for iPhone and iPad that connects to a Mac's built-in screen sharing, and also to VNC and RDP computers. It was #91 in Utilities on the US App Store's paid chart on 16 November.
details: The App Store version costs $1.99 with no in-app purchases; the app's code is open source. Recent updates added touch control for Macs, a Quick Input option, keeping the Mac awake during a session, iPhone Duo support, and microphone and touch support for RDP. It's made by Metamerism LLC and came out on 16 October.
means: If you need a file or app on your Mac while you're away from it, this lets you see and use its screen from your phone.
todo: Turn on Screen Sharing in your Mac's settings before you leave, then add the Mac in the app.
thumb_words: CONTROL YOUR MAC FROM YOUR PHONE
